text: その　きかいで　きのみの　こなを　つくってきて　もらえんかの？

structure.jp: きのみの　こなを　つくってきて
structure.en: go make Berry Powder and come back

patterns.name: 〜てもらえないか
patterns.span: つくってきて　もらえんかの
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus もらえないか is a way to ask a favour: 'could I get you to do this?'. もらえん is the old-man short form of もらえない, and の softens it. つくってきて　もらえんかの = 'could you go and make it for me?'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb means you go and do the thing and then come back. つくってきて = 'go make it and come back'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a noun tells you what tool is used to do something. その　きかいで = 'with that machine'.
